task_description: HADDOCK3 analysis of barnase-barstar complex (1BRS) using SKEMPI 2.0 validation data
methodological_commitments: Parse and analyze 1BRS PDB structure (barnase-barstar complex)
Extract interface residues from the complex structure
Query SKEMPI 2.0 for mutation data on 1BRS
Calculate binding affinity changes (ddG) from SKEMPI data
Generate visualization of interface and mutation effects
Validate structural features against experimental affinity data
expected_figures: Structural visualization: interface residues mapped on 3D structure
